selected_crucible_bounties_4.title_en: Erdős $500–$10,000 Bounties & Anthropic Lean 4 Formalization Crucible
selected_crucible_bounties_4.title_es: Recompensas de Erdős ($500–$10,000) y Crisol de Formalización en Lean 4
selected_crucible_bounties_4.cool_fact: Paul Erdős offered cash checks from $25 to $10,000 for open problems in combinatorics and number theory; in 2025–2026, AI agents + Lean 4 formalization (including Anthropic's 13-million-line Fermat's Last Theorem proof in anthropics/fermats-last-theorem and Challenge/XiPrime.lean in anthropics/formal-math) began closing out decades-old conjectures with zero human hand-waving.
selected_crucible_bounties_4.cross_field_analogy: Like placing radio towers along a highway so no two pairs of towers share the exact same distance (a Golomb ruler / Sidon B_2 set): prevents wireless interference in 6G and radar arrays while bounding prime gaps.
selected_crucible_bounties_4.governing_law: a_i + a_j = a_k + a_l ⇒ {i,j} = {k,l} · |A ∩ [1,N]| ≤ √N + N^(1/4) + 1 · 0 sorry in Lean 4
selected_crucible_bounties_4.how_to_participate: Use the live Sidon B_2 & Lean 4 Proof Crucible to test dense projective-plane constructions and export a zero-sorry Lean 4 tactic skeleton.

selected_crucible_bounties_4.title_en: $5M XPRIZE Quantum Applications & Unitary Foundation `unitaryHACK` Bounties
selected_crucible_bounties_4.title_es: XPRIZE Quantum Applications ($5M) y Recompensas Abiertas `unitaryHACK`
selected_crucible_bounties_4.cool_fact: The $5M XPRIZE Quantum Applications (Google Quantum AI + GESDA) rewards quantum algorithms that solve UN Sustainable Development Goals like room-temperature FeMoCo fertilizer, while Unitary Foundation's unitaryHACK pays cash bounties to anyone who closes open GitHub issues in quantumlib/Stim, PySCF, Qiskit, PennyLane, and Mitiq.
selected_crucible_bounties_4.cross_field_analogy: Like untangling a knotted headphone cord using ZX-calculus 'spider fusion' rules: every non-Clifford T-gate you cancel in software saves 1,458 physical superconducting qubits in the dilution refrigerator!
selected_crucible_bounties_4.governing_law: N_phys = 2 d² N_log + N_factory(T_count) · p_L ≈ 0.03 (p/p_th)^((d+1)/2) · ΔE ≤ 1.0 kcal/mol
selected_crucible_bounties_4.how_to_participate: Scrub the ZX-Calculus T-Gate Compression & Surface-Code Distance sliders to hit chemical accuracy (< 1.0 kcal/mol) under a 500,000-physical-qubit hardware budget.

selected_crucible_bounties_4.title_en: $100M XPRIZE Carbon Removal & IStructE Net-Zero Structural Slab Challenge
selected_crucible_bounties_4.title_es: XPRIZE Carbon Removal ($100M) y Reto IStructE de Losas Estructurales Cero Neto
selected_crucible_bounties_4.cool_fact: Replacing flat reinforced concrete slabs with FEniCS/dolfinx SIMP topology-optimized Michell ribs (Folio E.11) printed via Roussel 3DCP (Folio E.10) and cured with mineralized CO2 (Folio E.09) slashes floor carbon from 180 kg CO2e/m² below the 45 kg CO2e/m² award threshold—turning city buildings into permanent limestone carbon sinks.
selected_crucible_bounties_4.cross_field_analogy: Combining the hollow trabecular arches of an eagle's wing bone with coral-reef calcium carbonate mineralization—verified on bug-free anthropics/theorem-riscv control silicon.
selected_crucible_bounties_4.governing_law: e_CO2 = ρ_c V_frac c_clinker − Δm_CaCO3 ≤ 45 kg CO2e/m² · c(ρ) = Uᵀ K(ρ) U
selected_crucible_bounties_4.how_to_participate: Balance SIMP volume fraction V/V_0 against CO2 carbonate mineralization uptake to achieve a negative-or-sub-45 kg CO2e/m² structural floor rating.

selected_crucible_bounties_4.title_en: $1M Holcim Sustainable Construction & $3M Global Cooling Prize Canopy
selected_crucible_bounties_4.title_es: Premio Holcim ($1M) y Global Cooling Prize ($3M) de Envolventes sin Red Eléctrica
selected_crucible_bounties_4.cool_fact: Air conditioning consumes 10% of global electricity, yet a 52 mm compression-only vault (designed in open-source compas-dev/compas) or a 12 kg/m² tensegrity dome clad in an 8–13 μm radiative sky-cooling membrane (modeled in NREL/EnergyPlus) drops interior temperatures by 5.2 °C under direct midday sun with zero grid electricity and zero steel rebar.
selected_crucible_bounties_4.cross_field_analogy: Uniting Rafael Guastavino's self-supporting terracotta cathedral shells with the Saharan silver ant's infrared-beaming prism hairs.
selected_crucible_bounties_4.governing_law: det(H_Φ) > 0 (0 kg Rebar) · q_cool(8–13 μm) = P_rad(T_s) − P_atm − P_sun ≥ 95 W/m²
selected_crucible_bounties_4.how_to_participate: Tune vault rise-to-span f/L and 8–13 μm selective emissivity ε_LWIR to pass both the Heyman zero-rebar limit state and the Global Cooling Prize 5× climate impact benchmark.
